question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Distinguished
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dignified.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Distinguished"** means someone or something that is respected and admired for excellence or importance. (प्रतिष्ठित)

 
 
• **Example: **She is a distinguished scientist known for her groundbreaking research.
 
 
 
• **"Dignified"** refers to someone who is worthy of respect and honor, having a serious and composed manner. (गंभीर)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the chaos, he maintained a dignified demeanor throughout the meeting.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dignified.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mirrored** (प्रतिबिंबित): Showing a reflection of something.

 
 
• **Example:** The lake mirrored the surrounding mountains perfectly.
 
 
 
• **Dramatic** (नाटकीय): Something that is striking or exaggerated.
 
 
• **Example:** The play had several dramatic scenes that kept the audience on the edge of their seats.
 
 
 
• **Mediocre** (साधारण): Something that is of only average quality.
 
 
• **Example:** The performance was mediocre and failed to impress the judges.
